- Signing authority: Rachel Kim, VP Legal (primary); if Rachel is out, Priyom Das (Head of Partnerships) has delegated signing authority up to $250k commitments.
- E-sign platform: we prefer DocuSign for enterprise deals but can use AdobeSign if you have a strict preference; either is fine as long as the audit trail is included.
- Routing: we can run parallel routing (two envelopes) to speed execution — one envelope for GlobeFintech to sign, and a matching envelope for Redwood signatory/countersign. Envelopes will be linked and we will lock final PDFs to ensure the audit trail matches.
- Data transfer: Redwood will execute the standard SCCs. We'll attach the SCC addendum in the final envelope and provide the subprocessors list snapshot.

I attached a clean DPA (Redwood_DPA_Clean_v2.pdf) and a signatory-matrix.csv with the proposed order. Proposed plan:

1) Create two DocuSign envelopes simultaneously (GlobeFintech envelope + Redwood envelope) and set them to "cross-reference" so both parties receive executed PDFs once both envelopes complete.
2) GlobeFintech signs within 48 hours. Redwood legal signs within 48 hours thereafter.
3) If GlobeFintech prefers a single-envelope sequential flow, we can switch — advise on preference.

I'll ask Rachel to confirm the delegated authority and whether we want ID verification (KBA) on GlobeFintech's signer. If you need corporate officer countersignatures, flag which role at GlobeFintech will sign (CEO/CFO).

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Clean_v2.pdf, signatory-matrix.csv

Thanks,
